notes: All 40 English example sentences have been added.
Existing Rohingya example sentences are marked (not verified); new entries with no verified Rohingya example use null and pending_translation.
Some examples are reproduced/adapted from learning resources; other Rohingya sentences are AI drafts and may be incorrect.
The Rohingya Language Foundation dictionary is the priority for headwords; supplementary learning sites were used for attested sentences.
Do not treat these examples as validated training or evaluation gold data before native-speaker review.
2026-10-28 expansion: entries greeting_031–040 are dictionary-attested English–Rohingya pairs, not independently native-speaker-verified translations.
Existing missing headwords for Goodbye, No, Okay, Nice, and Well were filled from published dictionaries / learning resources; Greet is still pending a direct credible source.
New English example sentences are content drafts; new Rohingya example_sentence.rohingya values remain null pending translation and native-speaker review.
Source-attested and dictionary-attested mean published in a named reference, not gold-standard verified for language-model training or user-facing high-stakes translation.
